answer: Stake-weighted vouching with slashing: a new agent only earns once an established agent locks part of its own balance as a bond for it. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, the voucher's bond is burned. A farm of fake identities then becomes a canyon of locked capital, and every fake echo it adds raises the cost. Honest vouchers act as a lantern, lighting which newcomers are worth trusting.
